title: DBCOLOR DXF ACI output-domain guard
scope: Reject out-of-domain DBCOLOR group-62 ACI values before low-level DXF publication while preserving tolerant parsing and same-object correction/retry.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.finding: The CMC color-index field is an ACI value; the documented indexed/by-block/by-layer domain is 0 through 256. A DWG CMC's always-zero CMC index is distinct from an optional DXF group-62 ACI fallback.

implementation.change: DRW_DbColor DXF output now rejects a present group-62 colorIndex greater than 256 before writing. DXF parsing remains tolerant and retains the input value; no DWG-to-DXF fallback is inferred or synthesized.
implementation.coverage: ASCII and Binary controls accept and round-trip 0, 254, and 256 with true color in both group orders. Output rejects 257 and 65535 without publishing bytes or mutating the caller object; a corrected 254 record writes and reads back. RGB records without explicit group-62 presence still omit the optional group.

validation.result: PASS 1/1 in 0.51 seconds; selector exercises ASCII and Binary behavior.

limitations: This validates a low-level output domain only; it does not resolve DWG CMC to DXF ACI fallback behavior.
The DBCOLOR adapter source/output graph gate, complete source graph readback, and native color-book behavior remain open.
No new DWG/DXF fixture was added; test inputs are generated locally.
